analysis.purpose: A cross-process advisory lock over the derived state directory, so two indexing runs — or an enrichment save racing a reindex — can never corrupt the derived index.
responsibilities: Serialize writers to the derived index directory
Allow concurrent readers of the committed soul
Release reliably so a crashed run does not wedge the repo

businessRules.rule: The soul tolerates concurrent reads, but the derived index store does not, so only writers are serialized.
businessRules.rationale: Locking reads too would make the server block behind an index run for no benefit.

edges.rationale: This file implements the crib lock.
